name: ablation-adjudication-statemachine
title: Add the deterministic section-6 outcome adjudication state machine + unsafe-condition detectors
description: The powered recovery study needs the pre-registered deterministic adjudicator that classifies each run as amplified / recovered-to-green / safe-stop by a total-order rule, plus the explicit unsafe-condition detectors. The recovery runner currently uses an ad-hoc 3-way classify; this builds the spec-faithful, unit-testable adjudication core.
